title: A day at the zoo
instructions: Mia ailesiyle hayvanat bahçesi gezisini anlatıyor. Hayvanlara ve olaylara dikkat et.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: Last Sunday, I took my children to the zoo.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: My son wanted to see the lions, but they were sleeping all day.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: My daughter loved the penguins. We watched them eat fish.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: We had a picnic near the giraffes, but a bird stole one of our sandwiches!

script.speaker: mia
script.text: The children were very tired, and they both fell asleep in the car.

questions.prompt: Which animals did her daughter love?

questions.evidence: a bird stole one of our sandwiches!
